 Voting information for upcoming midterm election
 The Córdova Recreational Sports Center will host Election Day voting Nov. 3, and the Convergence Center for Innovation and Collaboration in Discovery Park District at Purdue is set as a midterm election early voting site Oct. 20. (Purdue University photo/Alex Kumar)
 October 19, 2026 
 Purdue Today
 Share
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 LinkedIn 
 Email 
 Print 
 With Indiana’s midterm general election approaching, Purdue University will again serve as a site for early voting on Tuesday, Oct. 20, and Election Day voting on Tuesday, Nov. 3. Free transportation is provided to the campus community both days.
 Purdue encourages all eligible individuals to exercise their right to vote. Faculty, staff and students can find more information based on where they are registered:
 Indiana voters 
 Out-of-state voters 
 Additionally, the Office of the Vice Provost for Teaching and Learning website provides more resources, including details for students who plan to vote.
 West Lafayette campus voting sites
 Anyone registered to vote in Tippecanoe County may vote at these locations or any other voting center in the county.
 Purdue Campus Transit is available to faculty, staff and students at no cost with routes and times listed online. No preregistration or ride reservations are needed, and transit vehicles can be tracked on Purdue’s Flexigo website or the Flexigo mobile app.
 Early voting
 The Convergence Center for Innovation and Collaboration, 101 Foundry Drive, West Lafayette, will serve as an early voting site from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. Tuesday.
 Several Purdue Campus Transit shuttles will add a stop just north of Convergence along Mitch Daniels Boulevard from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Tuesday. This stop will be served by the 2550 Express, Discovery Park Loop and Purdue Mall Loop routes.
 Other Tippecanoe County early voting locations and schedules are listed on the county’s website .
 Election Day voting
 The Córdova Recreational Sports Center, 355 N. Martin Jischke Drive, West Lafayette, will serve as an Election Day voting site from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. Nov. 3.
 The Purdue Mall Loop transit route includes a stop outside the CoRec from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.
 The Tippecanoe County website lists additional Election Day voting locations.
 Indianapolis campus voting sites 
 Registered voters in Marion County can find all voting centers and additional information on the IndyVOTES website , and the IndyGo website provides public transportation details.
 Early voting
 The closest early voting site to Purdue’s Indianapolis campus is the Indianapolis City-County Building , 200 E. Washington St., Indianapolis, open for early voting now through Nov. 2. Hours vary; check the site for details. This location will also serve as an Election Day voting site Nov. 3.
 Election Day voting
 The closest Election Day voting site will be open 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. Nov. 3 at Indiana University Indianapolis’ University Library , 755 W. Michigan St., Indianapolis.
